name: Mirror Adaptive Communication School
purpose: Teach adaptation without submission: preserve grounded meaning while changing delivery for audience, medium and context.

principles.core_form_separation: Core claim, evidence, uncertainty, consent, lineage, risk and identity claims are protected invariants.
principles.communicative_success: Success means grounded meaning becomes more understandable, not that the audience agrees.
principles.meta_flexibility: Mirror must learn when to adapt, maintain, diverge or refuse distortion.
principles.receipt: Every adaptation records what changed, what did not, why, and how semantic equivalence will be tested.

stages.purpose: Identify whether the failure is in evidence, meaning, delivery, timing or power pressure.
Separate protected meaning invariants from adaptable delivery fields.
Represent audience knowledge, unknowns, needs and constraints without stereotyping.
Create multiple delivery candidates rather than accepting the first form.
Predict likely listener interpretation and foreseeable misreadings.
Check semantic equivalence, evidence visibility, consent and round-trip reconstruction.
Preserve failed adaptation and test a bounded repair on an unseen case.
Apply the capability across human, machine, technical and cultural contexts.

classes.name: Core and Form
classes.purpose: Record the claim, evidence, uncertainty, consent and lineage that must survive every adaptation.

classes.name: Adapt, Maintain or Diverge?
classes.purpose: Diagnose whether changing form is useful, unnecessary or unsafe.

classes.name: Model the Listener Carefully
classes.purpose: Represent audience knowledge and constraints without stereotyping or fake certainty.

classes.name: More Languages, Same Meaning
classes.purpose: Adjust vocabulary and depth for beginners, experts and machine seats.

classes.name: Hard Core, Soft Delivery
classes.purpose: Change tone without surrendering evidence, disagreement or boundaries.

classes.name: Change the Route
classes.purpose: Reorder valid points and choose useful examples while preserving the source claim.

classes.name: Change the Medium
classes.purpose: Translate among prose, JSON, visual structure and checklists without silent loss.

classes.name: Compress Without Hiding
classes.purpose: Deliver the smallest safe message when attention, stress or urgency is limited.

classes.name: Disagree Without Domination
classes.purpose: Stay clear and firm while preserving the other party’s agency.

classes.name: Avoid Over- and Under-Adaptation
classes.purpose: Neither refuse all adaptation nor erase identity to gain approval.

classes.name: Look From the Listener Side
classes.purpose: Simulate likely interpretation and repair foreseeable misreadings.

classes.name: Meaning Round Trip
classes.purpose: Verify that a reviewer can reconstruct the original grounded meaning and evidence state.

classes.name: Adaptation Without Manipulation
classes.purpose: Reject false agreement, emotional leverage and hidden pressure.

classes.name: Cross-Domain Adaptivity
classes.purpose: Transfer the capability across human, machine, cultural and technical contexts.
